mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is causally linked to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as reduced borrowing costs stimulate corporate investment and equity valuations.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20d returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% signals economic weakness that triggers risk-off sentiment, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 6.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong payroll growth (PAYEMS > 137k) and elevated unemployment (UNRATE > 6.5%) indicates a labor market that is simultaneously expanding and weakening, signaling economic uncertainty and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect (PAYEMS and UNRATE together) fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%), higher interest rates increase the cost of capital and reduce corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST < 800k) signals weak consumer demand and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 800.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals a contraction in the real economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI reading above 235 (CPIAUCSL > 235) signals elevated inflation, prompting expectations of monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 235.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales (RSAFS > 425 billion) signal robust consumer demand, supporting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 425000.
